root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before entering the post-scan delimiter walk in `scanf_one()`, `streampos` must remain strictly below `streamsize - 1`; otherwise the first `streampos++` moves the cursor to the one-past-end index that the next delimiter probe dereferences.
root_cause_criterion.description: The ASan root cause is the missing end-of-buffer guard on `while (streampos < streamsize)`. The fixed program enforces the absent conjunct `streampos < streamsize - 1`, blocking the delimiter probe when the scan started on the last in-bounds byte.

nodes.state: In the first delimiter-walk iteration, `streampos++` advances the cursor to `streamsize`, i.e. from the last valid byte to the one-past-end index.
At the delimiter probe, the index used for `buf[streampos]` equals `streamsize`, so the read is exactly one byte past the heap buffer.

edges.via: streampos before the first delimiter-walk increment
edges.relation: The same `streampos` value admitted by the missing guard is the value incremented in the first loop body iteration.
The one-past-end `streampos` produced by `streampos++` is reused unchanged as the index in the next `buf[streampos]` delimiter test.
